requirements.description: The user prefers a property near healthcare services. Per the 'near' proximity expression, the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.
The user requires energy class D or better, so the filter includes all classes from D upward (A1, A2, A3, A4, B, C, D).

The user explicitly requires at least 1,600 sqm of gross floor area. The 30-person capacity is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and proximity to healthcare services are outside the reference columns and are not extracted here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 1600 AND healthcare >= 75 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the four extracted requirements: surface_area at least 1600 sqm, healthcare proximity score at least 75, energy class A1 through D, and location within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine on latitude/longitude. Strictest condition (surface area) first, distance last. Results are ordered by distance to the reference point ascending.
